The School Sports Day: 运动会上的接力赛与友谊。
Friday is the school sports day. All the students come to the playground with their teachers.
There are many games: running, high jump and ball games. The most exciting one is the relay race at the end.
Amy runs the last part for her class. She is very fast, but another girl is just behind her. Amy gets to the finish line first. Her class wins the race! Everyone jumps and cheers.

# title: Which game is the most exciting?
column4: 最刺激的是最后的接力赛。
